run_bm_raymarching: run the bm_raymarching benchmark to measure raymarching performance across different raymarcher types and ray counts
benchmark_EmissionAbsorptionRaymarcher: benchmark the EmissionAbsorptionRaymarcher with varying numbers of rays and points per ray
benchmark_AbsorptionOnlyRaymarcher: benchmark the AbsorptionOnlyRaymarcher with varying numbers of rays and points per ray
test_raymarcher_performance: test raymarching performance using fvcore benchmark across 27 combinations of raymarcher type, ray count, and points per ray
refactor_bm_raymarching: refactor the bm_raymarching function to add new raymarcher types or adjust the n_rays and n_pts_per_ray grid values
